flags.why: This kinship use is regional Northern Vietnamese and needs a Northern tag ([linguistic study](https://vjol.info.vn/index.php/NNDS/article/download/15667/14080/)).
Bá does not mean to crash into or hit ([dictionary entry](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%C3%A1)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.

flags.why: Ác nhân is literary language for an evildoer, so leaving it untagged suggests ordinary casual usage.
For fruit, ủng means spoiled or rotten, rather than merely overripe or mushy ([dictionary entry](https://vietnamthuquan.eu/TacPham/tu-dien-tieng-viet-1713/chuong-61)).
Hũ can denote a small jar and does not require a large vessel held with two hands ([dictionary entry](https://vdict.com/h%C5%A9,3,0,0.html)).
